newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains brought down by stg in final stages.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains brought down by stg in final stages.

text.p: LIFFE grains moved lower on a small day's volume.

The market only came to life in the final stages, as sterling firmed to over 3.01 marks, bringing prices down and teasing out a few bids, traders said. "The last half hour went pretty quickly," one trader said.
But overall, volume was "pretty dire," he said.
On wheat, November was most active, with 74 lots of a total 185 traded. It last changed hands 1.00 stg lower at 83.00 stg, the day's low.
Barley also fell, with active November last traded 0.50 stg lower at 78.75 stg. There were 20 lots done on November of a total 25.

Activity on the delivered market was minimal. Physical market traders said that most market players were too busy eyeing the early stages of the harvest. Farmers have been busy in southern areas cutting barley in ideal sunny conditions over the weekend.
